routedItems.cause: ESTABLISHED, not inferred. createFooting queried terrain.isSolidVoxel(cx, cy+1, cz) unclipped. createLiveAgentSurfaceTerrain's solid test falls through to generator.shouldVoxelExist, which keeps answering OUTSIDE the rendered/collided cube. A probe against the real generator at the real identity (getWorldGen(50, STORY_SEED, "-1,-1"), seed 3215739679) prints the actual column at S as cells 23:S 24:S 25:S 26:S 27:. with renderedRadiusCells(50) = floor(50/2) = 25 — so the generated bulge at cell 26 is one cell outside the cube and was read as an INVISIBLE CEILING above the ground she was standing on. At the landing area the same probe prints 25:S 26:. , which is exactly why supported was TRUE there and false for the whole approach: the verifier's "localised, not global" measurement, explained. The jump table is consistent: a lift into cell 26 returned TRUE because the phantom at 26 was "solid" and 27 was not — an artefact of the same unclipped read, not evidence that the ground top face is y=53.
routedItems.reproduction: main/src/story/world/CommonGroundWorld.test.tsx, 17 tests over the REAL generator, REAL voxelSystem, real seed/planet/world identity, plus the real director seam (registerCommonGroundWorld -> commonGroundPlayerPose -> getCommonGroundProbeSnapshot().supported -> commitCommonGroundSurveyStart). It asserts the cause from the generator, carries the exact published hardware pose (-26.303072, 50.98897476203079, 12.015123) and the authored 51.05, and replays the whole measured height response including the still-cell-25 hovering band the late clarification named.
routedItems.resolution: Three bounded clauses in createFooting, no shared terrain/physics change, no threshold widened. (1) The PROCEDURAL fallback is clipped to the rendered cube, exactly as agentSurfaceNavigation.ts:376-390 already does for agents; the support cell must itself be real, so cell 26 can no longer carry a body. (2) Real placed/exposed voxels are NOT clipped: solid = voxelSystem.hasVoxel(...) || (rendered && terrain.isSolidVoxel(...)), because addVoxel has no radius guard and a block a player actually built at cell 26 is meshed, collided and visible. Hazard follows the same shape. (3) CONTACT_TOLERANCE = VOXEL_SCALE/8 = 0.25: the feet must be ON the support column's nominal top face. cell(y - 1.05) alone accepts -0.95..+1.05 around that face, so clipping the ceiling on its own would have called a body hovering most of a voxel up "grounded". The band strictly contains both qualified heights — authored 51.05 (+0.05, the same authoring epsilon carried in PLAYER_CENTER_CLEARANCE) and the measured resting 50.98897 (-0.011, the 0.01 COLLIDER_HALF_EXTENT inset plus solver penetration) — and refuses everything a quarter voxel or more off it. Water is deliberately left unclipped, matching the same shipped clause. Every clause can only REJECT poses the old predicate accepted, except at cells the cube does not render.

one-foot-over-the-hole rejection at a real cell boundary
interior rendered ceilings (dug pit + replaced block)

routedItems.cause: ESTABLISHED from the actual boot ordering, and it is NOT the app-phase candidate. For a ?story=ch13-home deep link appState computes DEEP_LINK true, so phase is already "playing" from module load. The real path is two lines: storyDirector.ts ends with subscribeStory(syncBeat) plus an immediate syncBeat(), and initStoryFromSave activates the beat inside App's useState initializer — so enterCommonGroundBeat("ch13-home") and its anc.cg.home-steady publish run synchronously during render, BEFORE the first frame exists. App.tsx then mounts <StoryDirectorDriver paused={!worldGenReady || !initialRenderReleased || ...} />, so for the entire world-generation and shader-warmup boot every frame takes the !foreground branch and calls suspendCommonGroundPresentation("pause"), whose unconditional clearPendingAnchors destroyed the queued entry anchor before any tick could retry it. firedAnchors had already latched it, so it could never be re-noted, and signedSceneAvRuntime's earlierRequiredAnchorPending guard then refused fault-reviewed and return-chosen behind it for the whole beat. That is exactly the measured shape: firedAnchors both, activationSequence 0, history [], pendingAnchors already empty at 11 ms, first accepted anchor hatch-boarded in the next beat.
routedItems.reproduction: commonGroundDirector.test.ts "survives the boot: the entry anchor is retried after world-gen and warmup": the synchronous entry seam with the rail elsewhere, then thirty suspend("pause") frames standing in for world-gen and warmup, then the first real tick, then the two real F acts.
routedItems.resolution: A separate, BOUNDED beat-entry queue. It is populated only by enterCommonGroundBeat (in practice exactly one id, anc.cg.home-steady), drained once by the first tickCommonGround of that beat whatever the outcome, and dropped whole by clearAnchorQueues on every beat, run, world, actor, reset, exit and release transition. A pause or visibility loss leaves the chapter ON the beat, so it survives those two and only those two — which is what the boot actually reports itself as. StoryDirectorDriver.tsx was NOT edited: all existing UX and final-texture cancellation is unchanged.
preservedRules: The live install acknowledgement anc.cg.cell-installed is published mid-beat and still goes through the ordinary pending queue, which a pause still empties on the spot — asserted by the rewritten "never defers a MID-BEAT acknowledgement across a pause, a mute or a Continue".
No unbounded queue: at most one entry anchor, one retry, then empty.
No manufactured receipt, no activation history written, no replay, no deferred audio unlock.
The completion token's cancellation path (cancelCommonGroundFinalTexture) is untouched.
routedItems.notProved: Whether a continuous station->home entry behaves identically is unmeasured here; only the deep-link/boot ordering is reproduced in source.

routedItems.cause: DEMONSTRATED, and it was a real failure rather than a speculative one. RECEIPT_SATISFIED_ANCHORS keys every survey predecessor on story:ch13-route-tested, and there are only six durable ch13 milestones, so a Continue taken in the MIDDLE of the survey can hold no receipt that excuses them. Built through the real seam — open the demonstration, start the recording, draw three real samples of the short route, serializeCommonGround -> WorldSave -> localStorage -> loadWorld -> stageCommonGroundWorldPayload -> hydrateCommonGround validator -> chapter seam, cold runtime, fresh AV ledger — the reload then walks to E and offers the span, and anc.cg.route-offered is REFUSED with a completely empty activation history.
routedItems.reproduction: commonGroundDirector.test.ts, three new cases: "resumes a mid-DRAWING Continue and earns the next new anchor", "resumes a mid-TESTING Continue without replaying his walk or her offer", and the negative control "excuses NOTHING from a restore that has no recording at all". All use the actual WorldSave round-trip with a Map-backed localStorage, the real validator and the real signedSceneAvRuntime; none hand-builds a snapshot.
routedItems.resolution: surveyStateSatisfiedAnchors() in signedSceneAvRuntime.ts extends the SAME transaction-chain doctrine the milestone map already states to the one lane whose chain has no durable milestone yet. It reads only a VALIDATED, hydrated, actor- and world-scoped chapter snapshot; a recording that exists is proof of the acts that are the only legal way to produce one (commitCommonGroundSurveyStart runs only from awaiting-start, which only commitCommonGroundDemonstrationOffer produces from idle, and anc.cg.repeated-measure is published on every tick of those two phases). An offered span additionally excuses trace-drawn and route-offered. It is consulted ONLY to answer "is that predecessor still pending?": it activates nothing, writes no activation history, replays no cue or shot, marks no milestone and creates no new event id.
boundaries: Reads only state with hydrated === true, so a live in-session survey still activates its anchors in the ordinary order.
No new milestone constant and no new creative event id was added. The six real durable ch13 milestones are unchanged.
The FINAL proofs stay keyed to their durable milestones: route-tested, reciprocal-crossed and complete are not excused by any saved state.
A restore with no working and no accepted slot excuses nothing (negative control asserts route-offered and route-tested are both still refused).
A foreign actor or foreign world payload hydrates to null in the existing validator and therefore excuses nothing.
